conf.description: syslog-relay daemon-operational / json: JSON-envelope variant of the daemon-operational pipeline (rsyslog template(type="list") jsonf properties / syslog-ng format-json()); same bounded pinned message-form lookup as syslog-raw, computed before the batched rename.

conf.comment: syslog-relay / daemon-operational / json. The json template types the envelope (timereported as rfc3339, syslogfacility/syslogseverity as numbers, structured-data as its own hyphenated key) but leaves msg opaque, so the same bounded pinned message-form lookup from the syslog-raw pipeline still applies to msg: rsyslogd HUPed, action suspended/resumed+module, imuxsock ratelimit-drop, and syslog-ng starting-up/reload/connection-broken/queue-full-drop. structured-data contains a literal hyphen so it is read via __e['structured-data'] rather than rename/eval.add path syntax. Message wording is not a stable API across releases - re-test on every daemon point release. Direct route, no guard hop.
